**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

**Status: local implementation and verification complete.** The source, optimized

## Scope

v0.7.0 adds Self, Pairwise, and Grid plot selection for multi-record sessions. Grid
mode selects 2 through `min(6, loaded records)` distinct sequences, executes the
`n + n(n - 1) / 2` unique quick-overview comparisons serially, and displays the full
symmetric matrix with transposed pairwise mirrors. Opening a cell transfers its
sequence choice to the corresponding interactive Self or Pairwise plot.

The grid overview is bounded to 256 by 256 cells per unique comparison. Feature tracks,
Reset view, and current-view data/image export are unavailable in Grid mode and become
applicable again after an interactive cell is opened.
